scripts.test:unit: bun run build --filter=@reviewskits/core && bun run --cwd apps/server test:unit && bun run --cwd packages/sdk-core test && bun run --cwd packages/sdk-react test && bun run --cwd packages/sdk-vue test
scripts.cache:start: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml --profile cache up -d redis
scripts.cache:stop: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml --profile cache stop redis
scripts.storage:start: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml --profile storage up -d minio
scripts.storage:stop: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml --profile storage stop minio
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml down -v && bun run db:start && sleep 3 && cd apps/server && bun run db:push && bun run db:seed:admin
